$comment: Per-world generation settings (docs/WORLD_GENERATION.md §9, ADR 0050): the sliders the create-world screen shows, chosen once when a world is created and stored in its file (to change them, regenerate). Each slider drives one or more generator tunables (`drives`), by `target`, a fixed vocabulary the generator understands (gen.mjs `TARGETS`), and `op`: `scale` multiplies the tunable's value in its data file by the slider's (default 1), `set` makes it the slider's value × `factor` (default 1; the default × factor must equal the data file's value), `shift` adds the slider's change from its default, and `choose` (toggles) picks `values[0]` off, `values[1]` on (values[default] must equal the data file's). So every slider at its default is exactly the data files' terrain. `format` is the readout, `{v}` the value. `presets` are named sets of values (a slider not named keeps its default); `default` must be the empty one. Values are encoded per world as `id:value` pairs of the sliders off their defaults (`?gen=` in the create route, the world file, Welcome). Changing a slider's target, op, factor or default changes what a stored setting means: a new compatibility line. Run `node shared/worldgen/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails on stale output.

sliders.label: Land size
sliders.hint: How far the island reaches from the centre of the world.

sliders.label: Coastline roughness
sliders.hint: Smooth shores, or bays, headlands and offshore islands.

sliders.label: Mountain height
sliders.hint: How high the ranges are lifted.

sliders.label: Mountain ranges
sliders.hint: Long mountain spines on each face.

sliders.label: Rainfall
sliders.hint: More rain: more and bigger rivers.

sliders.label: Erosion
sliders.hint: How hard the rivers wear the land down: lower, wider valleys.

sliders.label: Rift lakes
sliders.hint: Plates pull the land apart into rift valleys that fill with lakes.

sliders.label: Snow line
sliders.hint: Snow lies above this height, and the pines' leaves turn snowy below it.

sliders.label: Treeline
sliders.hint: No trees grow above this height.

sliders.label: Tree density
sliders.hint: How thick the groves are, and how many trees stand between them.

sliders.label: Portals
sliders.hint: Shafts through the midplane between the faces (the seed picks between half and all of them).

sliders.label: Bedrock thickness
sliders.hint: The unbreakable layer on each side of the midplane.

presets.label: Default
presets.description: One large island: three mountain ranges, rivers to the sea, pine groves on the hills.

presets.label: Highlands
presets.description: A bigger, higher island of many ranges, snow low on the peaks and deep river valleys.

presets.label: Archipelago
presets.description: A ragged coast broken into islands and inlets, low hills and a warmer climate.

presets.label: Lake Country
presets.description: Rift valleys full of lakes, gentle ranges, heavy rain and thick forest.
